By the rate at which America is moving towards more left-wing policy today, if this shift continues at the same rate, by the year 2050 we would almost be guarranteed to be a socalist country. This is obvously only true though if every new generation is increasingly more leftist than the last, which is unlikely. For example, only about 26% of boomers say socalism is good for a country, while with Gen X it is about 32%, Millineals about 42%, and shockingly, whith Gen Z it goes down to about 38%. So if this percentage continues to decline America will probably remain a free market capitalist country, but if not we will probably be seeing socialism by 2050 at least. Overall with the WWIII America would probably still be a major world power if we remain away from socialism as a whole, but if we were to become socialist this would obvously destroy American wealth and prosperity and most likely lead to America no longer being a world power.
